description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling user timezone settings. It includes helper functions, retrieved user preferences, and renders a Smarty template for setting the timezone.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving beans such as 'Administration'.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Utility class for handling timezone guesses and listings.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template engine class for rendering Smarty templates.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents the current user, used here to get user preferences.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings from the Administration bean.

methods.name: guessTimezone
methods.description: Guesses the timezone based on user offset or default.

methods.name: getTimezoneList
methods.description: Returns a list of available timezones.

methods.name: getPreference
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences, such as the selected timezone.
